title: Power Ring settings (ring.json)
description: Everything about Power Ring: hotkey, look, profiles and the circles of actions. Save the file and the ring reloads; an invalid file is reported and the previous version stays active.

hotkey.description: Global shortcut that opens the ring at the pointer. Needs Ctrl, Alt or Win. Map a mouse button (for example the MX Master Sense Panel) to it in Logi Options+.

startProfile.description: Id of the profile shown first. Omit for the first profile.

profiles.description: 1 to 5 profiles (Dev, Perso, Work...). Buttons 1-5 above the ring switch profile; Tab cycles; the mouse wheel over the ring too.

icon.description: An icon name, a Segoe Fluent Icons code point such as "E943", or a file path ending in .png, .ico, .jpg or .exe (an .exe shows its own icon).

appearance.description: Sizes are in Windows display units (scaled with the monitor). Colours override the theme.

theme.description: system follows the Windows app theme.

slotSize.description: Diameter of each action button. Must be less than half of ringSize.

centerSize.description: Diameter of the centre button (home / back).

slotRadius.description: Distance from the centre to the buttons. Omit to compute it.

accent.description: Hover/selection colour. Omit for the Windows accent colour. A profile's accent wins.

slotHover.description: Button colour under the pointer. Omit to use the accent.

showNumbers.description: Small 1-8 numbers next to the buttons (keys 1-8 run them).

showLabels.description: Name of the hovered button under the centre.

accent.description: Accent colour while this profile is shown.

items.description: One circle: 1 to 8 buttons, numbered clockwise from the top.

icon.description: Omit to pick one from the action.

action.description: run: start a program (target = command or .exe, args optional). url: open an http(s) or mailto address. folder: open a folder (path, or downloads/desktop/documents/pictures/videos/music/home). keys: press a key combination in the window that was in front (target like "Win+Tab"). text: copy target text to the clipboard. screenshot: Windows region snip. screen-to-clipboard: whole screen under the pointer to the clipboard. powerops: show Power Ops (target = its .exe path, optional when it is running). group: a sub-circle (items), omit action and just give items.

target.description: What the action uses: program, address, folder, key combination or text. Environment variables like %USERPROFILE% work.

items.description: Sub-circle. At most 3 levels in total (ring > circle > circle).
